messages:
emma (partnerships): Heads up — GCP Marketplace product onboarding just asked for our security/compliance bundle: latest SOC2 report, pen-test report, and a list of artifacts (S3 links or presigned). They want everything in by next Tuesday. Can @sam and @lia own? Here’s the partner portal: https://partner.gcp.marketplace/upload :point_up:
sam (security): On it. Quick Q: do they want full pen-test raw findings or a redacted/published summary? Also need to confirm scope (prod infra only vs. staging + prod).
oliver (product): We already have SOC2 Type II PDF and evidence zip from last audit. I can surface the artifacts. S3 path: s3://redwood-artifacts/compliance/2025-soc2/ (will post presigned links).
lia (legal): I can handle redaction and confirm NDA requirements. If the vendor report contains customer data we need to redact before upload. Also we should check the marketplace contract template for any disclosure clauses.
deploy-bot: Created bucket: s3://partners/gcp-evidence-1763456789, access-grants pending. Use `/grant-bucket-access partners/gcp-evidence-1763456789 sam@redwood.com oliver@redwood.com lia@redwood.com` to provision.
sam (security): Thanks bot. Emma — can you confirm the exact files they expect? e.g., `SOC2_report.pdf`, `pen_test_full.pdf` vs `pen_test_summary.pdf`, `scoped_asset_list.csv`, `mitigation_plans.md`? Also do we need signatures?
emma (partnerships): From the GCP checklist: they want (1) SOC2 report PDF, (2) latest external pentest report (redacted if necessary), (3) list of in-scope IPs/hostnames, (4) attestations/contacts, (5) any third-party attestations (KMS/HSM). I copied their snippet:```- SOC2_Type_II_2025.pdf
- pentest_external_2025_redacted.pdf
- in_scope_inventory.csv
- vendor_attestations.md
- contact_sheet_vendors.csv```
oliver (product): I'll run inventory and produce `in_scope_inventory.csv`. ETA EOD today. Also will attach the presigned URLs here when ready.
lia (legal): I'll review pentest for PII and redact if needed. Also confirm we should use the standard marketplace NDA for vendor sharing — pinging @emma for sign-off.
emma (partnerships): Yes use our standard marketplace NDA (https://redwood/legal/marketplace-nda). @lia please use that as the baseline. Also tag @sam when you've redacted so he can validate.
sam (security): Good. Also need to know the pen-test vendor name and contact for a short attestation. If we don't have the vendor willing to share raw report, we can provide a signed summary + remediation timeline.
oliver (product): Vendor: ShieldSec Labs. Contact: secops@shieldsec.io. I’ll reach out to request permission to upload the redacted report to the GCP portal.
emma (partnerships): If ShieldSec needs an NDA, Lia will send one. Timeline: we need upload + portal confirmation by next Tue 09:00 PDT.
sam (security): I’ll prep a short attestation template. Lia—if you can share the redacted doc by tomorrow morning I’ll sign off on security edits.
lia (legal): Will do. Also note: redact customer names + IPs that are not in the in-scope inventory per policy.
oliver (product): Uploaded draft inventory here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/partners/gcp-evidence-1763456789?region=us-west-2&prefix=in_scope_inventory.csv (will convert to presigned link after permissions).
emma (partnerships): Perfect. Once permissions are set, @sam please confirm and I’ll submit to the portal. Please add any quick notes if we should request an extension from GCP (I prefer not to). :thumbsup:
sam (security): Confirmed — I can review as soon as redacted pentest is in the bucket. Also recommend we include `mitigation_plans.md` with statuses for each finding to satisfy marketplace risk questions.
emma (partnerships): Good call. Oliver — can you add `mitigation_plans.md` with current statuses?
oliver (product): Yep — adding now.
sam (security): Also note file naming convention for portal: no spaces, lowercase, use underscores. Example: `soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf`.
emma (partnerships): Copy that. I'll handle the portal upload once @sam sign-off. Thanks everyone — tagging this thread as the canonical place for uploads. If anything else comes up I’ll update here. :rocket:
